notes.title: MDM Surprise Release!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/4bb5b097b15b979ec2d4c8ae7eb83260fd071d40.png
New Restock Keyword
Since the release of Mayor Lindr⚡️a few months ago, two particular effects (Human Shield and Mayor Lindr) have occupied our imaginations. Both of these cards add new ones to the shop, similarly to other tokens generators, but there is a hidden flaw of unlimited copy creation. 

The act of adding the same card over and over (Rally, Conversion, Dr. Daisy) requires heavy commitment from the beginning of the match, which is risky and boring at the same time. Peak game design...❤️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/4082b4d603d64657ee1df3fc2b62f015e060fde4.png

Packaging this multiplication functionality in a new Restock keyword has opened an enormous number of possibilities. We no longer have to rely on Double and Triple effects, that while fun are a bit clunky, because the total price of cards has to be doubled or tripled.

 With this solution we can divide the large upfront cost⚡️⚡️⚡️ into a few smaller chunks ⚡️+⚡️+⚡️making the deckbuilding experience friendlier and deck creation quicker. The best part is the extra flexibility! Too many copies of the same card can make the deck dull and uninspiring. Players will now be able to choose exactly how many cards they want!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/5948cceb69fdf8b0852fc4303204a4e3ba0e165c.png

Metal Duke Mox Release Guide
SUR5☢️ 30th Survivor - MDM can be unlocked just for 2160🟨 credits or 525 💎 crystals! Cards provided by this advanced-tier, defense character create a strong foundation for all Barrier based archetypes. It's also a second character that pushes the design philosophy of Hybrid card type.

"Decades of hoarding all things into one hand-shaped megastructure was considered insanity. Total Collapse has changed people's minds. They began to admire this act of unintentional resourcefulness and praised its creator as Metal Duke Mox. With the influx of attention, MDM had a sobering moment and left, but was no longer a slave to materialism."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/1fce2c8492e6160b861b2aed2a927b692dfa705b.png

Metal Duke Mox has the simplest destroy effect of all available Survivors in the game. This unending hatred towards all consumer goods comes at the cost of his own health 🔥🔥🔥 To protect from self-harm and enemy invade cards, use Fortify and manipulate metal waste around.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/4a4f434684a1321a5615b581fcc03c69f5d108d6.png

He is not the only one in this fight and devoted Acolytes are glad to do everything their reverend prophet says. Vandalize and Reserves are both great ways to use barriers when there is no life loss 💔 threats present.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/43d03b8578409a3cfc3cf6bb597912fec966b60e.png

Balls of Steel and a good timed Booby Trap is everything you need to completely stomp an opponent. These two (as well as other hybrid cards) don't do much damage 💀, but they can totally clog enemy decks! 💩💩💩

Suggested Companions

 Braindead  (synergizes in all aspects)
 Vex (Fixes energy issues and matches waste types)
 Phoebe (Combos with barrier generating cards)
 General Nur ad-Din (can block self-damage with armor)
 Sister Senn (life gain offsets life loss, more Hybrid cards in deck)

Survivor Changes

 Submarine now Recreates Twice and has new "On Draw" effect: Lose 2💔

Vex

 Totem has been renamed to Balance Totem.

Braindead

Mayor Lindr

 Mayor Lindr text now uses Restock keyword.
 Human Shield text now uses Restock keyword.

S.F.T. now loses 3 💔 instead of 2

Thanks to everyone reading this article and supporting SUR5☢️ We hope that you will enjoy this months release. Next Survivor ([strike]Codename TOD[/strike]) will be a gamechanger that explores Trash and Restock mechanics in a way that was not seen before❤️🌱🌱🌱

~SUR5 Company

notes.title: Hybrid Cards + Sister Senn Release!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/c14201217bcd7c97d8b10627f1f7b36e16080e73.png
Hybrid cards were in our plans since the very beginning of the game, awaiting their movement alongside Sister Senn. We are very happy to finally awaken them from deep slumber. While at first glance the new card type might seem underpowered, it absolutely makes up for it with their extra versatility, DOUBLING the possibilites!!! 🖤❤️💜💙

How do they work!? It's very simple and elegant design! Players can purchase Hybrid cards by dragging them to either top side of the screen (as Invade card for enemy) or to the bottom side (as Basic card for their own deck) This truly innovative change will be a permanent feature that allows us to pack more SUR5☢️ into SUR5☢️ 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/bdf46ce1c191c8fb8262e6594641bc0d02d52c61.png
Sister Senn Release Guide
Sister Senn can be unlocked for 4320 🟨 credits or 825 💎 crystals. Cards she brings to the bood stained table works very well on their own, but are most efficient when paired with other Life Gain ❤️ Survivors. Her tanky kit and 4 Hybrid cards can extend game time to the new lengths!

"Metal fangs drilled into Sister Senn's skull itch every time she spills blood. However, time for the pleasures will come later. First she needs to harvest and freeze organs of the donor. Lamashtu pays a fortune for body parts that closely match the necessary genetic profile..."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/edef9d070a15fcec9d97a367e84d09a673341c7f.png

Access to a vast DNA🧬 database of potential targets comes at a huge cost. All bloodlink agents must replace their teeth with metal implants that cause immense discomfort when their cravings are not satisfied. This modification ensures that pseudo-vampires are loyal and always happy to serve a bad cause 🩸🩸🩸

Hunger 💀💀 Direct Damage effects can be triggered with Sister Senn or using traditional Tweak effects! Be extremely cautious when gifting this to opponent as it can be easily turned against you 💔 💔 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/678d8a9e51f544f6a45d3c5a81fdee2e793f6e7b.png

Transfusion can be a powerhouse or menace, depending if the deck has enough Life Gain❤️effects. It's usually a good idea to wait a little before the purchase. Note the card description reads "since last turn" meaning that effect includes life received from Blood Agent💉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/8592055d1adfb49394ef642eb59d7611741571fb.png

Deep Rest has by far the most powerful healing effect in the game, comparable to dealing 3 points of direct damage. It can put a Hunger at the bottom of the deck, to be later drawn with Stitched - triggering a draw bonus 🔥🔥🔥 

Survivor Changes
In our pursuit of creating the very best deckbuilding game ever™ we also decided to change some of the older cards to make the Hybrid type feel more common. Similarly to the Spark update we will be consequently adding them from this point forward. We are super excited to see how players can use these newfound powers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/030be6078d432d1cc4c51f09c834b3679b0e9c83.png

Father Redwood

 Torment is now Hybrid type instead of Invade type.

General Nur ad-Din

 Phosphorus Bomb is now a Hybrid type instead of Basic type.

Phoebe

 Crimelord is now Hybrid type instead of Invade type.

Right now this change is more about lore flavour than actual utility, letting poor Phoebe continue her addiction with a help of nasty drug lord

Dr Daisy

 Overgrow is now Hybrid type instead of Invade type.

Mrs. B

 Royalties are now Hybrid type instead of Invade type.

Braindead

 Preparations combo now correctly uses requried waste from the combo.

QoL and Bug Fixes

Tied Arm, Tied Leg and Lifesteal from Mission 4-5 has been changed to Hybrid type for educational purposes.
Fixed bugs where some cards were not displaying illustrations and showed not_supported titles after destruction.
Fixed bug where Blowup was improperly displaying Traitor illustration.
Cards in the deck preview now have their names colored based on their type.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/a50e89eb61d06b6115e509bf856b24c889dea999.png

We are very thankful for everyone reading the message ❤️ As you can see Hybrid cards add even more complexity to the game in an ingenious, natural, gluten-free, non-gmo, blessed fashion. We still have many crazy ideas coming to improve all aspects of the SUR5☢️
~SUR5 Company

notes.title: Braindead Release!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/c7c3c8c47665d56e8a27ffe629973a38194e6169.png
Third month - third release! Braindead is waiting for you to be unlocked! This Expert Tier character (4320 🟨 credits) with Economy-Unity traits breathe fresh garbage air to the game, unlocking potential of many waste combos that were previously not possible🔥🔥🔥

Substituting missing brain tissue with social-media based hardware was partially successful. Braindead was alive, but his mind could be easily influenced by populist viewpoints. The battle against Lindr tyranny not only left him physically scarred, but also replaced his virtues with loose morals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/16b10a344f46e979aecd83e3a8de53b3e1c1740a.png

Braindead🧠 speciality is generating and utilizing high amounts of waste. His ability may not look like much, but when timed correctly it can provide exactly what you need for the combo. All trash is welcome thanks to the mid to late game effect of Segregation♻️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/238bf26d7955476386a8708dc08b2b820a18e849.png

When facing Scavenger its removal should be absolutely prioritized. While both copies deal no damage (when played), they can single handedly enable any combo in the opponent's hand. No scavanged trash is wasted with Toxic Fire🔥 that can hit for up to 6 damage 💀!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/778d1d74710f85ee8812b4082933244100597f7d.png

Single trigger of Scavenger ability can also combine with SUR5☢️ first two triple-waste combo cards: Preparations and Blow Up. These powerful new additions should be used very cautiously as they can easily make or break the game 💥

Survivor Changes
With this patch we want to make the experience of facing Heavy Invade cards feel less hopeless. We have removed the Recreate Always keyword from many cards and added lighter version: Recreate Thrice.

Destroying a card 2-3 times is functionally almost the same, but with a clear "way out" this should feel more forgiving and fair. Some cards like B.F.T. were not changed to continue crushing peoples dreams.

notes.title: Phoebe Release + New Defence Type
notes.content:
Barrier
The small things are often overlooked, but sometimes they are the most important. Barrier mechanic is much simpler than many of you expected! It was designed to resolve the hidden issue with the basic Armor🛡️, but what's the problem?
 
Armor can stop both Direct Damage💀 and Life Loss💔 from invade strategies. We artificially limited this effect to a handful of cards because it can resolve both of the threats leading to unfun "turtling" gameplay. With this new experimental effect we can stop invaders without relying on destroy cards, opening completely new deck archetypes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/15cb88e73656f7b61949ff8eb4ae3023d7fc926f.png

 Armor stops direct Damage
 Damage ignores Barrier
 Barrier soaks Chemical Damage
 Chemical Damage outwaits Armor

Phoebe Release
We hope you enjoyed your time with the TRX release last month, because we already have the next Survivor for you! For 4320 🟨 credits you can unlock a very versatile character Phoebe, who bridges the waste gaps between certain combos🔥🔥🔥

Phoebe's high intellect couldn't protect her from hazy years of crystal abuse. Rotten arms would be amputated without the merciful intervention of Mayor Lindr. After losing empathy to the rest of society, this victim of Stockholm syndrome has pledged her life to a new

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/5afe699537aebff5d6118fcf46bb9ce0a6320c0e.png

Forcefield is the first card with mentioned earlier Barrier. It can stop a lot of mid-range invade cards like Flat Earther, while also providing their dual waste that normally would be "wasted" when destroyed!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/5f470b5c1e3c8145bf99382a13be64cbe22818b9.png

Phoebe's general strategy is to cumulatate massive amounts of energy or deal huge damage in one turn (Traits: Attack-Foresight). We recommend waiting a few turns before purchasing her card, because it's not as effective in early phases as in late game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/c12d119e6dde0c1e6694d49f22ae045a77caea77.png

Watchdog is another experiment combining text triggers with symbols. In this case the doggie needs to be played as the very first card in a round - the energy must be obtained from the previous turn using Deploy or other store effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/8ad451b26cbb33ee967e7b0bf1ebfc414a78071d.png
This Survivor shares her card Frame with 2 others. Together they create a "faction" called NWG - New World Government, where Mayor Lindr makes the laws and distributes mind-controlling drugs to the public. Phoebe commands police forces and Mrs B terrorizes the private sector. A truly disgusting and corrupt combination! 🤮 🤮 🤮

Momentum Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/75898cd7c54343f193d236ea932aeb539f785c7f.png

This interaction was not planned at all when we designed the Double and Momentum mechanic, but if its fun then why not embrace it? Thanks to folks who suggested this change! This type of "secret" knowledge can create super cool situations and we are happy to explore this concept in future ❤️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/ef350e4cfbe6e26b67d527cf7aedff318e090085.jpg
We are currently working on a big purchasable item that will grant new players access to 20 Survivors and all Wildcards (Level 1). We believe that it's important to help people get to the game faster without having to grind all the items. Inside this pack there will be a hilarious Casual Mrs B Skin available only there (except next Brawl)! 😆

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/709d4613f892bd5b7947894d56902a31cc46c9f3.gif

Art update of Mrs.B character design. She has now black hair strand, belt full of ammo clips and golden knuckle-duster.

In the case of TRX it was more than 2 years!

Phoebe Spoilers

[previewyoutube=nFk4sJ8agX8;full][/previewyoutube]
SUR5 :radioactive: next Survivor is Mayor Lindr right hand - Phoebe that can be recognized from Story Missions. It's important to acknowledge that all Survivors are equal in power level and it often may be tempting to compare mechanically simple Vex with long-term gameplay of Mayor Lindr. From now on we will be referring to the characters difficulty instead of their price or misleading term "Tier".

Many players have asked our team to improve Training Bot game mode to support Invade card testing. Bot now has a special modifier that will estimate life loss based on the number of bad cards in deck. While this solution isn't perfect for now it has to be enough as we are focusing on other tasks.

notes.title: FREE Survivor TRX
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/7a786814c18f75953125fbc6d2f507462f92ddef.png
SUR5☢️ fist Invade Survivor - TRX (pronounced Tee-R,Ex) worth 8640 🟨 credits can be unlocked absolutely for FREE using promotional code: SCP524. In addition you will receive special SCP themed skin to make him look extra cute!!! ❤️❤️❤️

Hundreds feets underground, in a secret waste management facility genetic experiments take place. Attempts to create the omnivorous organism that would convert trash into energy had a breakthrough. Instead of pooping, TRX emits electricity through its ears. The results surpassed all expectations, creating an insatiable animal. 

*Promotional code SCP524 valid untill the end of February! After the promotional code expires the SCP skin will be available for purchase in store page.

TRX Quick Start

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/2a5a95d5fb1792618589aee2b5fbc91b2dd9d536.png

TRX can give a strong advantage early on because it can clog the enemy deck. Comeback effect unfavourably stacks cards while triggering small chunks of damage💔. The smaller the deck the more often it happens (opponent can counteract by making larger decks). Combo effect can bring back TRX to top where it can be tweaked to bite once again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/ec58b569a657d52db1c65905e7b0646ec3ac26a6.png

One of the design ideas of this Survivor was to counter the enemy decks from mindlessly drawing and playing cards. While it is very fun to do, it can become tiring and not exactly rewarding as we would like to. 4 copies of Rabies will punish any deck without destruction and Chew Through can exceptionally well mess up with opponent plans.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/2dfdd8fe4782ea8f37f4ac96991e6e816e9d7d22.png

The drawbacks of this cute animal are: total lack of🔥destroy effect, powerful, but hard to control trash effect (Pointy Teeth), mediocre ⚡energy generation (Fluorescent Vaccine). Be sure to complement the team composition with cards that balance these issues.

Suggested companions:
- Mr.s B (enemy tweaking, invade cards)
- General Nur ad-Din (reveal + energy + plastic waste)
- Murad (destruction + energy)
- Boney (energy + plastic waste)
- Pepper (destruction)
- Vigilante (to utilize Headshot)

We are listening!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/04b2bc230d2bbff438d5bc0a0d052c7ab926f46b.png

Leveling system was created many months ago as one of the first game features and certainly hasn't been updated in awhile. We have doubled the 🟨 credit rewards on all levels and moved Tomes to the earlier levels to make new players' experience more welcoming.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/803c28ba5cfc27aa53b490dca6d4b699fd40a736.png

In this update we have added descriptions for all blueprints that can be found in the recently launched Weekly Quest system to ease the learning curve. The usage for some of the blueprints can be confusing, because planned items still need to be implemented in the upcoming releases. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/238b00e7ffe6aca652e1cfd5b18183f98407e4bd.png

Don't worry! All sent and received items in SUR5☢️ are stored in the server database. With this patch there will be only visible items on the list that were not collected, so hopefully it will clear up players' suspicions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/bdc6405012d4598181f10f146b886035fee96d86.png

While we believe there are quite a few tooltips in the game, we have indeed omitted hovering tooltips for basic things like Waste, Energy, Armor. In the next updates we will be taking a look at all symbols to clarify all game mechanics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/c8fb3312755b6f396aca5b14d49b9f57bc8862e3.png

As always comments in the bug-report channel on Discord section are greatly appreciated, without your all help we wouldn't be able to find errors or identify our shortcomings. Every release we are continuing to make the very best PvP deckbuilding game ever.

Changes and improvements
- Increased Epic Journey rewards and moved Tomes to earlier levels.
- Increased Credit rewards in weekly quests.
- Added descriptions to all blueprints in the game.
- Added additional battlefield resources tooltips when hovering.
- Added additional music tracks to the game.
- Added ability to edit provided email in the game settings.
- Added ingame introduction in the Tutorial Section.
- Added ingame help video clips during tutorial missions.
- Added on-hover descriptions to Epic Journey and Weekly Quest rewards.

Bugfixes
- Fixed issue where you could hover cards during reporting opponent player.
- Fixed issue where you could hover cards during match warmup window display.
- Fixed incorrect information about how Credit Microchip works.
- Fixed graphic issue when displaying Neon Crypt Portrait
- Fixed multiple wide-screen scalling issues.
- Fixed minor visual artifact while displaying Victory/Loss animation.

Thank you for reading! As you can see we are constantly improving on all fronts. This is a very big project for our small team, but we believe we are offering something truly special and unique. You can help us grow our community by inviting friends, recording videos or asking favourite influencers to cover SUR5.
 ~team SUR5☢️

6 years ago our journey with SUR5 ☢️ started. Today we would like to share our 6 reasons why it began in the first place...

6 Reasons

Gambling Epidemic
Every year more and more games or even other products include lottery elements, loot boxes or boosters. Even when you buy pasta in a store there is a chance to win a luxury cooker. This is not how we remember the world. It became a new norm that prays on the compulsive behaviours of the weakest. This false sense of control creates society that "hopes" something will change their lives instead of taking action.

Economic Crisis
"The rich get richer and the poor get poorer". A story as old as the world, but taken to the extreme in 2025. By no means we are not opposed to accumulating wealth, but extracting every penny in order to satisfy insatiable investors has gone too far. Our small game made by just 2 people is an inexpensive refuge for individuals who want to take a break from predatory monetization and don't have to spend a dime while having fun.

Shattered Home
We are aware that there are tons of incredible deck building games out there. We love those titles, but predominantly they are single player experiences that make us disconnected from society. People keep jumping from one title to another repeating the same mechanics. SUR5 improves on a well established classic formula and together we can go even further. Creating a community where we share truly innovative mechanics.

Freedom of Speech
The idea behind "Freeworld" (original title) was to create a post-apocalyptic world where no governments and companies can censor our thoughts. A new beginning, big reset unlike what we have in real life... Apparently we can't handle the truth and need to be fed constant lies and misinformation. Disabling communication leads to creation of echochambers, separating people into groups and escalating real life conflicts.

Degenerating IQ
The constant reliance on technology for every task prevents the formation of new neurons and memories. This leads to the creation of a less intelligent and easily controlled society. SUR5 won't hold your hand. We believe in people's ability to understand complex ideas, learn and use their imagination. Hopefully these skills will help in building better reality for us all.

Reason #6
Sixth reason? Hmm... I forgot what that was. Oh I know! Remember to have fun. Not everything has to be serious or competitive. Those old days where we could waste all day playing games, making silly jokes and talking to friends. Without building a thick skin and the ability to accept other people's viewpoints (instead of trying to change them) the world will become more depressing each day.

Development

SUR5 might be one of the most ambitious indie games ever with over 160 000 lines of code and 800 hand painted illustrations made by just 2 people. Let's These highly advanced and specific mechanics be an inspiration for your own projects

The best way to create your own game is to start with pen and paper allowing your own thoughts to guide you in decisions of what is fun and what isn't.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/923f33dda054fa3880c073fe198747253b5bd62d.png

Greyboxing is the first step of building a functional prototype. The goal is to polish very solid foundation before heading towards working on details.

SUR5 as an online game needed specialized network code that requires understanding of how the internet actually works.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/a3886f6231dafc9e6cfb20d3bef07dafbbbfa3c7.png

Using art templates during the development can help to decide what the player will feel. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/c2c90ada1df34d69f8bffc4ef4f7794072f4fe46.png

Over the years a lot of features were crafted and separated into modules/subsystems.

Please help us share our message everywhere you can. I hope you will support our efforts in creating a strong and happy world. Have a wonderful time in 2025 and we welcome you in our small rebellious community.
~Team SUR5

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/c9f7a5301da47862388e3503f8c6d7238fdd2cb2.jpg
Purchase Suggestions
Will this remove all decision making skill from SUR5 changing it into hopelessly brain dead gameplay for the mass audience? No, the system doesn't use cutting-edge, multi-layered neural network artificial intelligence to guide your life choices. Instead it uses a weighted algorithm that will help new players with their first deck building experience. We are well aware that knowing all SUR5 cards from the beginning is a challenging task and this functionality should help in learning them all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/0ccf41feac97473039c30a472319feeaa40e2334.png

The suggestions change over time, prioritizing economy in early stages and damaging in late game. Cards are are now grouped under five tooltips:


 Damage - this tag suggests purchasing cards that can deal damage (normally or through combo).
 Defense - describes cards that can help with managing direct damage or invade damage.
 Economy - prioritizes energy and destroys effects. Trash is great, but often may confuse new players as they don't know what they are searching for.
 Synergy - checks cards inside the player deck and waste they generate. Suggestions are based on possible combos and other trigger related events.
 Threat - usually seen on non-damage Invade cards, but might be found used to describe deck manipulating effects or debt.

We would like to encourage you to follow the suggested cards even if you are a veteran player to share your feedback with us. The goal is to guide newcomers in building simple, usable (not perfect) decks that will be fun to play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/452855624c7de866c619be1faa7b3d3795233981.png

As announced in previous updates we decided to change the prices of all Wildcards upgrades. We hope that you understand that it was a necessary adjustment for longevity of SUR5. This shouldn't spoil the player experience too much as our game is still one of the most generous on the market. Now players will spend more time playing with the second level and perhaps unlocking the final upgrade will be appreciated even more.

notes.title: Werwent Release
notes.content:
Werwent

Local stories say that deep in the forest shadows lives a treelike cryptid nicknamed Werwent. They claim that the beast escaped from a nearby botanical laboratory. No one knows the truth, but one is for sure: whatever haunts people during the night does it for its own twisted pleasure…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/ca88405b2ff8d762bfed63097c85595378bee295.png

Waste combos are the bread and butter of SUR5 game design. This integral part is definitely not going anywhere and the number of possible combinations is still increasing at exponential rate. While we want to promote creativity as much as we can, we would like to provide some counter measures to stop the most broken playstyles that can deal 7+ damage every turn!

This is how Werewent was born with its hallmark card - Regenerate. It's definitely not the easiest to use, but it can counter crazy combos two times per game. We believe that this universal Survivor with expensive late game cards can provide a lot of value to any build.

Roadmap Update

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/75d3f3e22cac1913dea9e00a8563aac715a3829e.png

In the next few weeks we will be launching a Battle Rage event that is similar in functionality to Wild Growth, but with different rewards. This core event will occur once a month (after game release) and it's the main source of Ashes of Destruction. Together with Seeds of Tomorrow, Atomic coins, Scraps and Sprockets we have necessary materials to introduce more advanced blueprints.

In our research we found that the biggest challenge for new players is inability to correctly connect the overwhelming number of cards (especially when it's one of their first games, when they simply had no chance to learn them all). While some players enjoy finding ad-hoc solutions based on incomplete information, many may be lost. Nonoptimal, slow or failed decks Is one of the main causes of premature exit.

To solve this unpleasant experience we are introducing an Automatic Guiding System. This exciting feature will help new players by highlighting what they should purchase and why. If you worry that this function will replace skill, we'd like to ensure that the results are intentionally sub-optimal and they still need common sense to apply! Veterans can toggle-off this option in settings at any time.

After implementation of AGS, we will proceed with updating the Tutorial: integrating the highlight system, removing unnecessary story elements, focusing on the clarity. We are standing in front of the bold task of teaching a complex game to a broader card game audience who might never engaged with deck builders. We appreciate all feedback and support <3

To spice up the waiting time for the final release we also decided to introduce our new damage type: Chemical Damage. This exciting mechanic was in the works for many months and will be integrated to already released cards, as we believe it greatly increases the interactivity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/3d1ab5c851bc283f53277a1e90ec8091d2dde870.png

notes.title: Leaderboards Update
notes.content:
Dear rebeliants! We have just released a new update that contains an important feature - Leaderboards. It's a list that summarizes players' progress as they reach higher levels of enlightenment, but it's also a foundation for other systems planned ahead.

Our long-term goal is to reward exceptional achievements with special skins, invitations to tournaments and more. Menu can be accessed through the button underneath the player portrait with the number of Total Player Power.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/39a212b81fdf658d9de357cb2820f39674b16607.png

Total Player Power

The exact formula for Total Player Power is very complex and measures three main aspects:

Exploration
takes into account mission completions (including difficulties levels), Steam achievements and Tutorial status.

Rivalry Power
Takes into account participation in Casual Games. Brawl Games and Hall of Fame position.

Collecting Power
Takes into account all kinds of unlockable things like Survivors, Wildcards, Skins, Styles, Frames, Badges, etc.

notes.title: Rapid Growth Event + 7 Card Rule Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/950877f19aa70977f96cb9965c551ce8773999cf.png
Rapid Growth
In this event players can gather Seeds of Tomorrow by playing Casual games between 6-7 January 2024. This cyclical event will occur every 2 months providing a stable income of our new currency. Seeds of Tomorrow (SoT) can be exchanged for both customizable or utility items and unlike Credits they can be traded between the players.

You might have noticed SUR5's very first Blueprint for a Globe of Tomorrow (5 x Seed of Tomorrow + 2 x Sprocket). Currently this subcomponent has no usage, but we plan to expand crafting and recipes greatly in 2024. We are also very proud to show our latest skin: Galactic Murad Skin. This is a long term goal, but luckily you don't have to do this alone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251508/99e4ae6489aa1ad43632fc4b216f6c2de90459a2.png
7 Card Rule
Long time ago, during the testing of SUR5 we noticed that players who did not find energy generating cards were at significant competitive disadvantage. Gamers were forced to buy (only at the time) Survivor Murad. We knew that the correct solution was to add more starting options, but it required more time to develop and balance.

This came to the invention of "7 card rule" - the first 7 cards in shop (after Survivors) were chosen from the 0-3 energy cost range of, pulling less expensive cards early while pushing powerful win conditions, making the game smoother….

Side effect of that approach was - predictability as the game partially played by itself. Patterns of purchasing 1-2 energy generators, 1 destruction card followed by damage combo that exactly fitted symbols become too obvious. Some cards like Excavator, Carbon Copy or Harvest were not needed at that point, blocking SUR5 from reaching its full potential.

Single point damage cards  (Sacrifice, Light it Up, Chemitrail - 0-3 energy range) became a dominant  strategy that was not exactly in the spirit of constructing decks. This experiment revealed that unconditional damage cards were not priced correctly and we do not plan on reducing their cost.

We have permanently removed the "7 card rule" from Casual/Brawl Game mode. The feeling of building a deck around a “bizarre”, “suboptimal” or “trash” card was what we were missing the most and we are happy to reintroduce it leading to more satisfying gameplay. 

We can't wait to see how SUR5 will develop in 2024 and we hope you will stay with us to see it's glory!
